Container.Name: kw-proxy
Container.Overview: Outbound gateway for the KW edge (kw-proxy): a stock Squid that allows each registered KW container to reach only its own destination names, and refuses private and internal addresses on the resolved IP. NO PORT IS PUBLISHED: it listens on 3128 (allowlisted) and 3129 (userlinks) on the internal network only, and containers reach it as kw-proxy:3128. NETWORK: Network stays bridge in this template, because a template cannot create a network; set Network to the internal Docker network the operator created by hand before the first start. Its second leg is per host, re-attached by System Admin's host watcher (network.md rule 7), not by this template: br0 on one host, a bond0 macvlan with a registered LAN address on the other. No other KW container has a second network. CONFIG: squid.conf is mounted read-only from kw-edge. The destination lists (one per source, through the Destination allowlists Path) and the three operator include files (operator-sources.conf, operator-destinations.conf and operator-resolver.conf) are host-held, mounted read-only, and not in kw-edge. A missing operator include stops the proxy from starting, and an empty operator-sources.conf denies every request. A missing destination list means that source reaches nothing. RULE SYNC: the rules directory (read-write, holding rules.conf), the sync directory (read-only, the two scripts from kw-edge config/squid/sync) and the exception-rules directory (read-only, *.conf files; keep at least one) are Paths. The sync is on only when KW_EGRESS_RULES_URL and KW_EGRESS_TOKEN are both set; KW_EGRESS_POLL_SECONDS is optional. START: PostArgs carries the start command, /etc/squid/kw/sync/entry.sh with squid's arguments. The host sets ExtraParams to --entrypoint bash, which runs that script in place of the image entry point; this template leaves ExtraParams empty, so the flag is host-side. RESOLVER: operator-resolver.conf holds one dns_nameservers line naming the LAN's DNS servers; kw-edge config/squid/squid.conf:23 includes it. An empty file keeps the container's own resolver. LOG: the destination log is a host directory mounted at /var/log/squid; rotation is the host's logrotate, set by System Admin. RESOURCE LIMITS: CPU and memory are System Admin's per-instance values, recorded in this Overview. IMAGE: ubuntu/squid:6.13-25.04_edge pinned by digest, the same pin as kw-edge's pins.json.
Container.Description: Outbound gateway for the KW edge: lets each registered container reach only its own destination names, and refuses private addresses. Publishes no port; reachable on the internal network as kw-proxy:3128.

Config.Name: squid.conf
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host path of kw-edge's config/squid/squid.conf, mounted read-only at /etc/squid/squid.conf. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/squid/squid.conf.

Config.Name: Destination allowlists
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory holding one destination list per source, each named <source>.allow, mounted read-only, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/squid/destinations. The lists are host-held and kept outside any repo. A missing directory or file still starts; that source then reaches nothing, and so does a source whose file is empty.

Config.Name: Rules directory
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory for the rendered rules file (rules.conf), mounted read-write at /etc/squid/kw/rules. Mount the directory, not the file: the sync replaces rules.conf by rename. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/squid/rules. A missing directory stops the proxy from starting.

Config.Name: Sync scripts
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory holding egress-sync.pl and entry.sh from kw-edge config/squid/sync, mounted read-only at /etc/squid/kw/sync. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/squid/sync. The container starts through entry.sh, so a missing directory stops the proxy from starting.

Config.Name: Exception rules
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory of named-exception rule files, mounted read-only at /etc/squid/kw/exceptions. Keep at least one .conf file in it (an empty 00-empty.conf is enough): a missing directory, or one with no .conf file, stops the proxy from starting. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/squid/exceptions.

Config.Name: Operator sources include
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host-held file of source ACL lines, one per registered container: acl src_<name> src <container-internal-address>. Mounted read-only. Its path, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/operator-sources.conf, is set by the operator. A missing file stops the proxy from starting.

Config.Name: Operator destinations include
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host-held file of operator-owned destination names, one per line: acl dst_<name> dstdomain <host-name>. Mounted read-only. Its path, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/operator-destinations.conf, is set by the operator. A missing file stops the proxy from starting; an empty one adds nothing.

Config.Name: Operator resolver include
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host-held file holding one line, dns_nameservers followed by the LAN's DNS server addresses, which the proxy asks to resolve names. Mounted read-only. Its path, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/operator-resolver.conf, is set by the operator. A missing file stops the proxy from starting; an empty one keeps the container's own resolver.

Config.Name: Destination log
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host directory for the destination log (destination.log), writable by the proxy. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kw-proxy/logs. Rotated by the host's logrotate, set by System Admin.

Config.Name: KW_EGRESS_RULES_URL
Config.Description: Keystone's rules endpoint on the internal network, plain HTTP: http://<keystone internal address>:<port>/v1/internal/egress/rules. Blank keeps the sync off, and rules.conf stays as it is.

Config.Name: KW_EGRESS_TOKEN
Config.Description: Masked. The proxy's bearer token, made once in keystone's Admin console (shown once). The entry point removes it from the environment squid inherits. Rotating it in keystone ends the old one at once: set the new value and recreate the container. Blank while the rules URL is set makes the sync stop at start and restart every 5 seconds; the rules in force stay.

Config.Name: KW_EGRESS_POLL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Seconds between polls of keystone, 1 to 60. Blank uses 30. A value outside 1 to 60 logs a warning and uses 30.
